Background

Beshear was Kentucky attorney general before winning the governorship in 2019 and was re-elected in 2023, both times in a state that voted heavily for Donald Trump. He chairs the Democratic Governors Association.

Outlook

Beshear has said he is considering a run, has pitched Democratic governors as the party's face, and has held early talks with potential campaign staff, according to the Associated Press. Prediction markets price him around 4 percent. His red-state record is his main argument. He has not set a date for a decision.
